paragraphs.text: Sales of board games have risen every year since 2010, and the strongest growth is in games for two players that take under an hour. Cafés where games can be borrowed opened in most large cities.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Designers say the internet helped rather than hurt. Rules can be learned from a video, and a game that would once have sold a thousand copies now finds buyers in thirty countries.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Shops report a difficulty. A family entering a shop sees two hundred boxes and no way to tell them apart, so many buy the game they already know instead of a new one.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Libraries have begun lending games as they lend books. Losses are lower than expected: a missing piece is reported by the next borrower, and most sets come back complete.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Sales of board games have risen every year since 2010

explanation.en: Sales growth and where it is strongest → i.
explanation.kk: Сату өсімі және ол қай жерде күштірек → i.
explanation.ru: Рост продаж и где он сильнее всего → i.

items.quote: Designers say the internet helped rather than hurt.

explanation.en: The internet helped: video rules and buyers in thirty countries → ii.
explanation.kk: Интернет көмектесті: бейнеереже және отыз елдегі сату → ii.
explanation.ru: Интернет помог: видеоправила и продажи в тридцати странах → ii.

items.quote: A family entering a shop sees two hundred boxes and no way to tell them apart

explanation.en: Two hundred boxes and no way to choose — too much choice → iii.
explanation.kk: Екі жүз қорап пен таңдай алмау — тым көп таңдау → iii.
explanation.ru: Двести коробок и невозможность выбрать — слишком большой выбор → iii.

items.quote: Libraries have begun lending games as they lend books.

headings.text: Too much choice in the shop
